missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Пыль' stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Толстая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'на полке' shows location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Пыль' is the accusative direct object of 'вытираю', identical to the nominative for this feminine noun. 'Каждое утро' sets the frequency.
Strategic focus: Genitive of quantity. 'Пыли' is the genitive after 'много', expressing an amount. 'В комнате' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Пылью' is the instrumental describing what covers the table. 'Серой' agrees in the feminine instrumental, and 'покрыт' is the short predicate.

missions.phrase: Я думаю о пыли на книгах.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Пыли' is the prepositional form after 'о', expressing what one is thinking about. 'На книгах' adds the location of the dust.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Пыли' is the genitive after 'из-за', marking the cause. 'Я чихаю' states the result.
Strategic focus: Genitive specifier. 'Пыли' is the genitive specifying the content of 'облако'. 'Ветер' is the nominative subject of 'поднял'.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Пыли' is the dative after 'к', marking what is added to. 'Песок' is the nominative subject of 'добавился'.

missions.phrase: Дети играли с пылью на чердаке.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Пылью' is the instrumental after 'с', marking what they played with. 'На чердаке' gives the place.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Пыли' is the nominative plural subject in this technical sense of dust types. 'Космические' agrees in the plural, and 'атмосферу' is the accusative object.
